Put $$A= egin{pmatrix}a_1&\cdots&a_r&b_1&\cdots&b_r\ I_r&I_r\end{pmatrix}$$ and maximize $\sum_{i=1}^r(\mu_i+
u_i)$ subject to $A(\mu_1,\ldots,\mu_r,
u_1,\ldots,
u_r)^{\mathsf T}\leq\mathbf1$ and $\mu_i,
u_i\in\mathbb Q_{\geq0}$. Must there exist an optimal solution $(\mu,
u)$ whose image $A(\mu,
u)^{\mathsf T}$ differs from the image of every other optimal solution?
